slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Agents need sandbox AWS access
slides.subtitle: The agent can experiment, but it should not reach production.

slides.title: The rule
slides.body: A coding agent should never have a path to production. If it can reach production AWS resources, the setup needs to change.

slides.title: Disposable environment
slides.body: Agents run on a remote sandbox server. If the server breaks, I can recreate it. Real infrastructure changes still go through CI/CD.

slides.title: Temporary AWS access
slides.body: When an agent needs AWS for an experiment, it gets temporary credentials for a separate sandbox account.

slides.title: The useful boundary
slides.body: The agent has enough room to explore and break things, but only in the sandbox and only for a limited time.

slides.supportingText: The System I Built for AWS Access Without Keys.
